name: Policy tip
short_description: A short notice shown to the sender, for example in Outlook, telling them that a rule or policy applies to the message they are composing.

evidence.quote: a small note called a policy tip can appear to the sender in outlook
A policy tip. A pop-up that says something like, this email contains sensitive information
